test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: ​C bought a machine from B, who bought it from A. C bought the machine for ₹ 9,360. A and B earned profits of 30% and 20%, respectively, on this sale. At what price did A sell the machine?
solution:
Let us assume that the original price of the machine be Rs. x

A sold the machine to B at = Rs.(130/100) × x

And B sold the machine to C at = Rs. (130/100) × x

According to question:

(120/100) </
